\documentclass{amsart}
\usepackage{amsmath, amssymb}

% Real, common math.AG-style macros — covers the directive families
% the extractor must handle.
\newcommand{\R}{\mathbb{R}}
\newcommand{\Z}{\mathbb{Z}}
\newcommand{\Spec}[1]{\operatorname{Spec}(#1)}
\renewcommand{\baselinestretch}{1.05}
\providecommand{\Hom}{\operatorname{Hom}}

\DeclareMathOperator{\Pic}{Pic}
\DeclareMathOperator*{\colim}{colim}

\def\sheaf#1{\mathcal{#1}}
\edef\thisversion{v1.2}
\gdef\globalfoo{globalbar}
\xdef\xglobal{baz}

\let\oldepsilon=\epsilon
\let\varnothing\emptyset

% This comment must be stripped — it contains a fake \newcommand{\fake}{x}
% that should NOT appear in the macros list.

% Escape edge cases:
% the literal \% percent sign should not start a comment
% ie \%50 below stays in the body of any macro that contains it.

\newcommand{\halfoff}{50\%~off}

% Multi-line definition (brace-balanced over 3 lines):
\newcommand{\bigtheorem}{
  Let $X$ be a smooth projective variety.
  Then for any line bundle $L$ on $X$,
  the cohomology $H^i(X, L)$ is finite-dimensional.
}

\title{A test fixture for the preamble extractor}
